spec.upstream: the E201 declaration status (this module) + each face's own JSON
spec.question: E201 published which faces never teach their sign and E205 gated who reads them. The remaining half is the producer: a silent face that grows a NEW delta number exports its ambiguity to readers that do not exist yet, which no reader map can see.
spec.leaf_rule: numeric leaves whose key name carries a delta token (['delta', 'diff', 'difference']); list indices elided, so an extra era row is the same name
spec.violation_rule: needs_line AND a delta name appeared that the baseline lacks
spec.born_rule: a face absent from the baseline that carries delta names AND needs its line
spec.retire_rule: a face that disappears is reported, never failed
spec.exit: 0 clean / 0 after seeding / 3 a silent face grew a delta number

recall_gap.read: counted, not judged: an arm-paired pair is one level quoted twice; an 'anchored' residue name is a level; an 'offset' residue is a gap under a constant, which can carry a sign; 'unclassified' is anything the class table cannot name. So the token test is a FLOOR on coverage, never a claim of completeness.

honest: growth is measured between two runs of this leg, so a name added and removed between runs is invisible to it (same limit as the E205 reader ratchet)
the identity is the key path, so a RENAME shows up as one removal plus one addition and is reported as growth -- deliberate: a renamed number is a new number for every reader
the leaf test is a token test on the key name: a delta that is spelled without any of the delta tokens (['delta', 'diff', 'difference']) is invisible to this gate
shrinkage is reported and never failed: a face that retires a number gets smaller, which is the direction this gate wants
